text.line: Hi there, I’m Luna! Welcome to Day 1 of our learning adventure.
Today we’ll count together, rhyme, and meet some friendly animals.
Don’t worry, I’ll guide you every step of the way.
Just relax, take a deep breath, and get ready for some fun!
When you’re ready, tap Next to begin.
Let’s make today awesome—you’re a superstar!

sessions.title: Let's count the animals!

questions.question: How many cats do you see?
questions.ttsText: Look carefully and count the cats. Then choose the correct number!
questions.funFact: Cats can jump up to six times their length!

questions.question: How many dogs are there?
questions.ttsText: Count the dogs you see and pick the correct answer.
questions.funFact: Dogs have a sense of smell 40 times greater than humans!

questions.question: How many elephants do you see?
questions.ttsText: Take your time and count the elephants. Choose the right number!
questions.funFact: Elephants are the largest land animals in the world.

sessions.onFinish: Awesome counting! You are an animal counter star! 🌟

sessions.title: Find the animal pairs!
sessions.ttsText: Can you find all the matching animal pairs? Tap two cards to play!
sessions.onFinish: Awesome! You found all pairs! Superstar!
sessions.funFact: Did you know? Foxes have excellent memories and can remember food locations for months!

sessions.title: What is a Rhyme?
sessions.ttsText: Hi {childName}, how are you today? Benny will explain what a rhyme is. A rhyme is when words sound the same at the end, like cat and bat.

sessions.title: Let's Find the Rhymes!

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'cat'?
questions.ttsText: Listen to the words and choose which one rhymes with 'cat'.
questions.funFact: Cats can jump up to six times their length.

questions.question: What rhymes with 'star'?
questions.ttsText: Can you find the word that rhymes with 'star'?

sessions.onFinish: Awesome! You finished the rhyming game!

sessions.title: Which animal is this?

questions.question: Which animal makes this sound?
questions.ttsText: Listen to the sound and choose the correct animal.
questions.funFact: Dogs have an amazing sense of smell!

questions.question: Who is mooing here?
questions.ttsText: Listen to the mooing sound and pick the animal.
questions.funFact: Cows have best friends and get stressed when separated.

questions.question: Which animal makes this sound?
questions.ttsText: Which animal do you hear? Choose the right one!
questions.funFact: Cats can jump up to six times their length!

sessions.onFinish: Great job! You're an animal expert!

questions.question: Can you repeat the color sequence?
questions.ttsText: Watch the colors carefully. When it's your turn, tap the colors in the same order!
questions.feedbackCorrect: Great job! 🎉 You remembered them all!
questions.feedbackWrong: Oops! Watch closely and try again!
questions.funFact: Your memory is as sharp as an eagle's eyes!

questions.question: This one is a bit harder! Ready?
questions.ttsText: Ready for the next challenge? Watch the sequence and remember the order!
questions.funFact: Did you know? Memory games improve brain power!

sessions.title: Match the animals and objects!

questions.question: Tap each animal, then tap its home!
questions.feedbackCorrect: Great job! All animals are home!
questions.funFact: Did you know? Dogs have an incredible sense of smell, and bees live in hives called colonies!
questions.ttsText: Tap an animal, then tap its home. For example: dog to doghouse, bird to nest, bee to beehive.

questions.question: Match the fruit to the basket! Tap a fruit, then tap its basket.
questions.funFact: Apples float in water because they are made of 25% air! Bananas are technically berries.
questions.ttsText: Tap a fruit, then tap its basket. Tap apple and then the apple basket. Tap banana and then the banana basket.

questions.question: Match the animals to their shadow! Tap the animal, then tap its shadow.
questions.feedbackCorrect: Awesome! You matched the animals to their shadow!
questions.funFact: Elephants use their trunks as a nose, and cats can jump up to six times their length!
questions.ttsText: Tap the cat, then tap its shadow. Tap the elephant, then tap its shadow.

sessions.onFinish: Fantastic! You are a Tap-to-Match Pro!

sessions.title: Click the Animal!
sessions.ttsText: Get ready! When you hear the sound, click on the correct animal as fast as you can!

rounds.funFact: Cats react super fast to movement!
Dogs can hear sounds four times farther than humans!

sessions.onFinish: Awesome! Your reaction speed is amazing!

storyLines.line: Once upon a time, Luna the cat went on a magical adventure.
She met new friends and explored the night.
It was a night full of wonders!
